scope_change_reason: The catalogue's changed-helper-inventory path is occupied by PR1348 and its active claim. This task instead checks whether two already certified time-varying coordinate schedules compose into one exact lower-cost complex word; it adds no helper interface or kappa claim.
actual_scope: For the exact PR1263 frozen word, compose the PR1353 L248 and PR1350 L253 time-varying schedules in both orientations. Prove schedule support disjointness, additive invoice and fixed-pair optimality from the two pinned one-coordinate optima; verify the combined 712-column word and complete scalar bill.
bottleneck_link: A lower exact scalar invoice on the selected complex word is a supplier-circuit improvement, but the unchanged paid recursive profile means it does not move the selected kappa.
stop_rule: Stay with the fixed L248/L253 pair and both orientations. Stop after pinning and replaying the two predecessor schedules, verifying all 71 and 96 incident ADD IDs per orientation and their disjointness, reconstructing the combined word, checking all 712 formal columns, exact invoices and paid-profile preservation, and four fault controls. Do not search other coordinate pairs or claim a new kappa.
